_comment: Contenuto del gioco (nel repository dal 2026-11-23). MAPPA, 12 CARTE DI SETUP e 16 PERSONAGGI (risorse iniziali e pezzi A/B/C) trascritti dal proprietario/dalle foto il 2026-11-21. CORTE: 31 carte (tipo, risorsa, chiavi) trascritte il 2026-11-21. Abilita dei personaggi non ancora implementate. Dadi e valori numerici ancora segnaposto. CARTE AZIONE confermate dallo schema di riferimento (2026-11-21). Corte: 3/4/4 carte scoperte, Guild e Vox mescolate insieme (confermato). DADI e riserve (15 navi, 10 agenti, 5 citta, 5 porti) trascritti il 2026-11-21. PLANCIA (slot, chiavi 3/1/1/2/1/3, citta che liberano gli slot) e azioni del prelude dalla plancia, 2026-11-21. FINE PARTITA (33/30/27, 5 capitoli, spareggio per ordine di turno) e MARKER (2/0>4/2, 3/2>6/3, 5/3>9/4, girati dopo i capitoli 1/2/3) confermati il 2026-11-21. SETUP dal regolamento (2026-11-21): gioco base con pezzi standard e risorse dai pianeti A/B, personaggi come variante; riserva di 25 gettoni. 2 GIOCATORI: risorse sui riquadri = terzo giocatore nel punteggio (confermato). LORE: 28 carte (1-14 base, 15-28 pack) trascritte il 2026-11-21; effetti da implementare. CORTE CAMPAGNA: 15 carte (set "campaign", fuori dal mazzo nelle partite normali) trascritte il 2026-11-21. CAMPAGNA: 4 editti e la carta Evento registrati il 2026-11-21 (solo dati). TESTI di LEADER e LORE (nome e testo inglesi dalla libreria carte dell'editore, traduzione italiana in i18n.it) aggiunti il 2026-11-23.

courtCards.name: Loyal Engineers
courtCards.text:
If you **Provoke Outrage**, keep this card.
You may spend any resources as Material. You ignore Outrage when spending Material for its Prelude action.

it.name: Ingegneri Leali
it.text:
Se **Recate Oltraggio**, tenete questa carta.
Potete spendere qualsiasi risorsa come Materiale. Ignorate l'Oltraggio quando spendete Materiale per la sua azione Preludio.

courtCards.name: Mining Interest
courtCards.text:
**Manufacture (Build):** Gain 1 Material.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to gain Material up to your number of empty resource slots. If the Material supply empties, steal the Material instead.

it.name: Interessi Minerari
it.text:
**Fabbricare (Costruire):** Ottenete 1 Materiale.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per ottenere Materiale fino al numero dei vostri spazi Risorsa liberi. Se la riserva di Materiale si esaurisce, rubate il Materiale.

courtCards.name: Material Cartel
courtCards.text:
You keep the Material supply on here. *(You add it to Tycoon but can't spend it.)*
After **scoring**, Rivals discard all Material.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to steal 1 Material.

it.name: Cartello del Materiale
it.text:
Tenete qui la riserva di Materiale. *(Lo contate per Magnate ma non potete spenderlo.)*
Dopo il **calcolo del Potere**, i Rivali scartano tutto il loro Materiale.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per rubare 1 Materiale.

courtCards.name: Admin Union
courtCards.text: **Prelude:** You may place this card next to a face-up played Administration card. When the round ends, draw that card into your hand and discard this card.

it.name: Sindacato Amministrativo
it.text: **Preludio:** Potete posizionare questa carta accanto a una carta Amministrazione giocata a faccia in su. Alla fine del round, prendete in mano quella carta e scartate questa.

courtCards.name: Construction Union
courtCards.text: **Prelude:** You may place this card next to a face-up played Construction card. When the round ends, draw that card into your hand and discard this card.

it.name: Sindacato Edile
it.text: **Preludio:** Potete posizionare questa carta accanto a una carta Costruzione giocata a faccia in su. Alla fine del round, prendete in mano quella carta e scartate questa.

courtCards.name: Fuel Cartel
courtCards.text:
You keep the Fuel supply on here. *(You add it to Tycoon but can't spend it.)*
After **scoring**, Rivals discard all Fuel.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to steal 1 Fuel.

it.name: Cartello del Carburante
it.text:
Tenete qui la riserva di Carburante. *(Lo contate per Magnate ma non potete spenderlo.)*
Dopo il **calcolo del Potere**, i Rivali scartano tutto il loro Carburante.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per rubare 1 Carburante.

courtCards.name: Loyal Pilots
courtCards.text:
If you **Provoke Outrage**, keep this card.
You may spend any resources as Fuel. You ignore Outrage when spending Fuel for its Prelude action.

it.name: Piloti Leali
it.text:
Se **Recate Oltraggio**, tenete questa carta.
Potete spendere qualsiasi risorsa come Carburante. Ignorate l'Oltraggio quando spendete Carburante per la sua azione Preludio.

courtCards.name: Gatekeepers
courtCards.text:
When you **battle** in a gate, you may collect 2 more dice.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to place 1 ship in each gate *(unless out of play)*.

it.name: Guardaportali
it.text:
Quando **combattete** in un portale, potete prendere 2 dadi in più.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per posizionare 1 nave in ogni portale *(se non è Fuori dal Gioco)*.

courtCards.name: Shipping Interest
courtCards.text:
**Synthesize (Build):** Gain 1 Fuel.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to gain Fuel up to your number of empty resource slots. If the Fuel supply empties, steal the Fuel instead.

it.name: Interessi Navali
it.text:
**Sintetizzare (Costruire):** Ottenete 1 Carburante.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per ottenere Carburante fino al numero dei vostri spazi Risorsa liberi. Se la riserva di Carburante si esaurisce, rubate il Carburante.

courtCards.name: Spacing Union
courtCards.text: **Prelude:** You may place this card next to a face-up played Mobilization card. When the round ends, draw that card into your hand and discard this card.

it.name: Sindacato Spaziale
it.text: **Preludio:** Potete posizionare questa carta accanto a una carta Mobilitazione giocata a faccia in su. Alla fine del round, prendete in mano quella carta e scartate questa.

courtCards.name: Arms Union
courtCards.text: **Prelude:** You may place this card next to a face-up played Aggression card. When the round ends, draw that card into your hand and discard this card.

it.name: Sindacato delle Armi
it.text: **Preludio:** Potete posizionare questa carta accanto a una carta Aggressione giocata a faccia in su. Alla fine del round, prendete in mano quella carta e scartate questa.

courtCards.name: Prison Wardens
courtCards.text:
**Pressgang (Build):** Return any number of your Captives to gain any 1 resource for each.
**Execute (Influence):** Move any number of your Captives to your Trophies.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to place 3 ships in a system you control.

it.name: Secondini
it.text:
**Arruolare (Costruire):** Restituite un qualsiasi numero dei vostri Prigionieri per ottenere 1 risorsa a scelta per ciascuno.
**Giustiziare (Influenzare):** Spostate un qualsiasi numero dei vostri Prigionieri tra i vostri Trofei.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per posizionare 3 navi in un sistema che controllate.

courtCards.name: Skirmishers
courtCards.text:
After you roll in **battle**, you may reroll a number of skirmish dice up to your total Weapon icons from resources and cards.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to place 3 ships in a system you control.

it.name: Incursori
it.text:
Dopo aver tirato i dadi in un **combattimento**, potete ritirare dadi Incursione fino al totale dei simboli Armi sulle vostre risorse e carte.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per posizionare 3 navi in un sistema che controllate.

courtCards.name: Court Enforcers
courtCards.text:
**Abduct (Battle):** Capture all Rival agents from a card in the Court that has fewer Rival agents than your total Weapon icons from resources and cards.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to place 3 ships in a system you control.

it.name: Sgherri della Corte
it.text:
**Rapire (Combattere):** Catturate tutti gli agenti Rivali su una carta della Corte che ha meno agenti Rivali del totale dei simboli Armi sulle vostre risorse e carte.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per posizionare 3 navi in un sistema che controllate.

courtCards.name: Loyal Marines
courtCards.text:
If you **Provoke Outrage**, keep this card.
You may spend any resources as Weapons. You ignore Outrage when spending Weapons for their Prelude action.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to place 3 ships in a system you control.

it.name: Marines Leali
it.text:
Se **Recate Oltraggio**, tenete questa carta.
Potete spendere qualsiasi risorsa come Armi. Ignorate l'Oltraggio quando spendete Armi per la loro azione Preludio.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per posizionare 3 navi in un sistema che controllate.

courtCards.name: Lattice Spies
courtCards.text:
**Prelude:** Before any other actions, you may discard this to seize the initiative.
*You can't seize the initiative if you have it or if it's already seized this round!*

it.name: Spie del Reticolo
it.text:
**Preludio:** Prima di qualsiasi altra azione, potete scartare questa carta per sottrarre l'iniziativa.
*Non potete sottrarre l'iniziativa se l'avete già o se è già stata sottratta in questo round!*

courtCards.name: Farseers
courtCards.text:
When you **declare an ambition**, look at a Rival's hand. You may swap 1 card with them.
**Prelude:** You may discard this and any number of cards from your hand. Draw the same number of cards *(including Farseers)* from the bottom of the action discard pile.

it.name: Veggenti
it.text:
Quando **dichiarate un'ambizione**, guardate la mano di un Rivale. Potete scambiare 1 carta con lui.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta e un qualsiasi numero di carte dalla vostra mano. Pescate lo stesso numero di carte *(Veggenti compresa)* dal fondo della pila degli scarti delle carte Azione.

courtCards.name: Secret Order
courtCards.text: When you **declare** Keeper or Empath, do not place the zero marker.

it.name: Ordine Segreto
it.text: Quando **dichiarate** Custode o Empate, non posizionate il segnalino Zero.

courtCards.name: Loyal Empaths
courtCards.text:
If you **Provoke Outrage**, keep this card.
You may spend any resources as Psionic. You ignore Outrage when spending Psionic for its Prelude action.

it.name: Empati Leali
it.text:
Se **Recate Oltraggio**, tenete questa carta.
Potete spendere qualsiasi risorsa come Psicoenergia. Ignorate l'Oltraggio quando spendete Psicoenergia per la sua azione Preludio.

courtCards.name: Silver-Tongues
courtCards.text: **Prelude:** You may discard this to steal a Guild card or resource.

it.name: Lingue d'Argento
it.text: **Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per rubare una carta Gilda o una risorsa.

courtCards.name: Loyal Keepers
courtCards.text:
If you **Provoke Outrage**, keep this card.
You may spend any resources as Relics. You ignore Outrage when spending Relics for their Prelude action.

it.name: Custodi Leali
it.text:
Se **Recate Oltraggio**, tenete questa carta.
Potete spendere qualsiasi risorsa come Reliquie. Ignorate l'Oltraggio quando spendete Reliquie per la loro azione Preludio.

courtCards.name: Sworn Guardians
courtCards.text:
Rivals cannot steal your resources and other Guild cards. *(In battle they can steal this first and then spend {key}.)*
If this card is stolen, bury it. *(Place it on the bottom of the Court deck.)*

it.name: Guardiani Giurati
it.text:
I Rivali non possono rubare le vostre risorse né le vostre altre carte Gilda. *(In combattimento possono rubare prima questa carta e poi spendere {key}.)*
Se questa carta viene rubata, seppellitela. *(Posizionatela sul fondo del mazzo Corte.)*

courtCards.name: Elder Broker
courtCards.text:
**Trade (Tax):** Choose a Rival city you control. Swap 1 resource with that Rival—take a resource of that city type from them, and give them a resource they don't have.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to gain 1 Material, 1 Fuel, and 1 Weapon.

it.name: Anziano Mediatore
it.text:
**Commerciare (Tassare):** Scegliete una città Rivale che controllate. Scambiate 1 risorsa con quel Rivale: prendete da lui una risorsa del tipo di quella città e dategli una risorsa che non ha.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per ottenere 1 Materiale, 1 Carburante e 1 Armi.

courtCards.name: Relic Fence
courtCards.text: **Prelude:** Once per turn, you may discard 1 resource to gain 1 Relic.

it.name: Ricettatore di Reliquie
it.text: **Preludio:** Una volta per turno, potete scartare 1 risorsa per ottenere 1 Reliquia.

courtCards.name: Galactic Bards
courtCards.text: When you **Surpass** or **Pivot**, before taking ***any*** actions, you may declare the ambition on your played card if an ambition has not been declared yet this round. Do not place the zero marker.

it.name: Bardi Galattici
it.text: Quando **Superate** o **Cambiate**, prima di svolgere ***qualsiasi*** azione, potete dichiarare l'ambizione della carta che avete giocato, se in questo round non è ancora stata dichiarata un'ambizione. Non posizionate il segnalino Zero.

courtCards.name: Mass Uprising
courtCards.text: **When Secured:** Choose a cluster on the map. You place 1 ship in each system of that cluster. Discard this card.

it.name: Rivolta di Massa
it.text: **Quando la Acquisite:** Scegliete un settore della mappa. Posizionate 1 nave in ogni sistema di quel settore. Scartate questa carta.

courtCards.name: Populist Demands
courtCards.text: **When Secured:** You may declare any ambition. *(An ambition marker must be Available.)* Discard this card.

it.name: Richieste Populiste
it.text: **Quando la Acquisite:** Potete dichiarare un'ambizione qualsiasi. *(Deve essere disponibile un segnalino Ambizione.)* Scartate questa carta.

courtCards.name: Outrage Spreads
courtCards.text: **When Secured:** You may choose an Outrage type. Each player *(even you)* must Provoke Outrage of that type. Discard this card.

it.name: L'Oltraggio Dilaga
it.text: **Quando la Acquisite:** Potete scegliere un tipo di Oltraggio. Ogni giocatore *(voi compresi)* deve Recare Oltraggio di quel tipo. Scartate questa carta.

courtCards.name: Song of Freedom
courtCards.text:
**When Secured:** You may return ***any*** one city you control to its player board. If you do, you may seize the initiative. Shuffle this card into the Court deck.
*You can't seize the initiative if you have it or if it's already seized this round!*

it.name: Canto di Libertà
it.text:
**Quando la Acquisite:** Potete restituire ***qualsiasi*** città che controllate alla sua plancia giocatore. Se lo fate, potete sottrarre l'iniziativa. Mescolate questa carta nel mazzo Corte.
*Non potete sottrarre l'iniziativa se l'avete già o se è già stata sottratta in questo round!*

courtCards.name: Guild Struggle
courtCards.text: **When Secured:** You may steal 1 Guild card from a Rival. Shuffle all Guild cards from the Court discard pile into the Court deck. Discard Guild Struggle.

it.name: Lotta tra Gilde
it.text: **Quando la Acquisite:** Potete rubare 1 carta Gilda a un Rivale. Mescolate nel mazzo Corte tutte le carte Gilda della pila degli scarti della Corte. Scartate Lotta tra Gilde.

courtCards.name: Call to Action
courtCards.text: **When Secured:** Draw 1 action card from the bottom of the action discard pile. Discard Call to Action.

it.name: Chiamata all'Azione
it.text: **Quando la Acquisite:** Pescate 1 carta Azione dal fondo della pila degli scarti delle carte Azione. Scartate Chiamata all'Azione.

courtCards.crisis: Return the declared ambition marker of highest Power to Available Ambitions.

leaders.name: Elder
leaders.text:
*Beloved*. After defending in **battle**, you may influence if the attacker took any Trophies. Rivals cannot Ransack the Court when they **battle** you.
*Just*. When you're **scoring** Tyrant, gain no Power for second place, and gain Power for second place if you get first place. *(Don't get bonus city Power.)*

it.name: Anziano
it.text:
*Amato*. Dopo esservi difesi in **combattimento**, potete influenzare se l'attaccante ha preso Trofei. I Rivali non possono Saccheggiare la Corte quando **combattono** contro di voi.
*Giusto*. Quando **assegnate i punti** di Tiranno, non ottenete Potere per il secondo posto, e ottenete il Potere del secondo posto se arrivate primi. *(Non ottenete il Potere bonus delle città.)*

leaders.name: Mystic
leaders.text:
*Attuned*. When you Copy or Pivot in order to **tax**, you gain 1 Psionic along with the taxed resource.
*Cryptic*. In **setup**, place agents on your Material and Fuel Outrage slots on your player board.

it.name: Mistico
it.text:
*Sintonizzato*. Quando Copiate o Cambiate per **tassare**, ottenete 1 Psicoenergia insieme alla risorsa tassata.
*Criptico*. Nella **preparazione**, posizionate agenti sugli spazi Oltraggio di Materiale e Carburante della vostra plancia giocatore.

leaders.name: Fuel-Drinker
leaders.text:
*Insatiable*. When you Copy or Pivot in order to **tax**, you gain 1 Fuel along with the taxed resource.
*Lavish*. After **scoring**, you must discard all of your Fuel if the Tycoon ambition was scored.

it.name: Bevitore di Carburante
it.text:
*Insaziabile*. Quando Copiate o Cambiate per **tassare**, ottenete 1 Carburante insieme alla risorsa tassata.
*Prodigo*. Dopo l'**assegnazione dei punti**, dovete scartare tutto il vostro Carburante se sono stati assegnati i punti di Magnate.

leaders.name: Upstart
leaders.text:
*Ambitious*. When you **declare an ambition**, you may gain any resource. *(You must declare the ambition before taking any actions, including Prelude actions from resources.)*
*Callow*. You can only **tax** Loyal cities if you control them.

it.name: Arrivista
it.text:
*Ambizioso*. Quando **dichiarate un'ambizione**, potete ottenere una risorsa qualsiasi. *(Dovete dichiarare l'ambizione prima di compiere qualsiasi azione, comprese le azioni Preludio delle risorse.)*
*Inesperto*. Potete **tassare** le città Leali solo se le controllate.

leaders.name: Rebel
leaders.text:
*Committed*. In **battle**, you collect 2 extra dice.
*Disorganized*. You cannot **move** more than 2 ships at a time.

it.name: Ribelle
it.text:
*Risoluto*. In **combattimento**, prendete 2 dadi in più.
*Disorganizzato*. Non potete **muovere** più di 2 navi alla volta.

leaders.name: Warrior
leaders.text:
*Tactical*. When you Copy or Pivot to **battle**, you may move before or after you battle. *(You may do this even if you spent a Weapon to let you battle.)*
*Violent*. When you're **scoring** Empath, gain no Power for second place, and gain Power for second place if you get first place. *(Don't get bonus city Power.)*

it.name: Guerriero
it.text:
*Tattico*. Quando Copiate o Cambiate per **combattere**, potete muovere prima o dopo il combattimento. *(Potete farlo anche se avete speso un'Arma per poter combattere.)*
*Violento*. Quando **assegnate i punti** di Empate, non ottenete Potere per il secondo posto, e ottenete il Potere del secondo posto se arrivate primi. *(Non ottenete il Potere bonus delle città.)*

leaders.name: Feastbringer
leaders.text:
*Charismatic*. When you Copy or Pivot in order to **secure** a card, you may influence before or after you secure.
*Generous*. To **declare an ambition**, you must give 1 Guild card to your Rival with the least Power.

it.name: Portatore di Banchetti
it.text:
*Carismatico*. Quando Copiate o Cambiate per **acquisire** una carta, potete influenzare prima o dopo averla acquisita.
*Generoso*. Per **dichiarare un'ambizione**, dovete dare 1 carta Gilda al vostro Rivale con meno Potere.

leaders.name: Demagogue
leaders.text:
*Bold*. When you **declare an ambition**, you may influence any number of cards in the Court once.
*Paranoid*. You cannot **secure** Guild cards with only 1 Loyal agent on them. *(You can secure Vox cards as normal.)* Ignore this if you Ransack the Court.

it.name: Demagogo
it.text:
*Audace*. Quando **dichiarate un'ambizione**, potete influenzare una volta un numero qualsiasi di carte della Corte.
*Paranoico*. Non potete **acquisire** carte Gilda con sopra un solo agente Leale. *(Potete acquisire le carte Vox normalmente.)* Ignorate questa regola se Saccheggiate la Corte.

leaders.name: Archivist
leaders.text:
*Learned*. After **setup**, gain 2 extra lore cards—draw 5 lore, keep 2, and scrap the other 3 *(returning them to the box).*
*Academic*. When you're **scoring** Tycoon, gain no Power for second place, and gain Power for second place if you get first place. *(Don't get bonus city Power.)*

it.name: Archivista
it.text:
*Erudito*. Dopo la **preparazione**, ottenete 2 carte Lore in più: pescate 5 Lore, tenetene 2 ed eliminate le altre 3 *(rimettendole nella scatola).*
*Accademico*. Quando **assegnate i punti** di Magnate, non ottenete Potere per il secondo posto, e ottenete il Potere del secondo posto se arrivate primi. *(Non ottenete il Potere bonus delle città.)*

leaders.name: Overseer
leaders.text:
*Ruthless*. Once per turn, when you **tax** any city or **build** a ship at a starport, you may hit the building to take that action again with it. If you destroy a Loyal city, you Provoke Outrage. *(If you destroy a Rival city, Provoke Outrage and Ransack the Court.)*
*Hated*. In **setup**, scrap 2 Loyal ships and 3 Loyal agents. *(Return them to the box.)*

it.name: Sorvegliante
it.text:
*Spietato*. Una volta per turno, quando **tassate** una città qualsiasi o **costruite** una nave in uno spazioporto, potete colpire l'edificio per compiere di nuovo quell'azione con esso. Se distruggete una città Leale, Recate Oltraggio. *(Se distruggete una città Rivale, Recate Oltraggio e Saccheggiate la Corte.)*
*Odiato*. Nella **preparazione**, eliminate 2 navi Leali e 3 agenti Leali. *(Rimetteteli nella scatola.)*

leaders.name: Corsair
leaders.text:
*Tricky*. When attacking in **battle**, you may reroll raid dice up to the number of different resources you have.
*Wary*. When attacking in **battle**, you cannot collect more assault dice than skirmish dice.

it.name: Corsaro
it.text:
*Astuto*. Quando attaccate in **combattimento**, potete ritirare un numero di dadi Razzia fino al numero di risorse diverse che avete.
*Prudente*. Quando attaccate in **combattimento**, non potete prendere più dadi Assalto che dadi Incursione.

leaders.name: Noble
leaders.text:
*Connected*. When you **declare an ambition** that's not declared, draw and secure the top card of the Court deck. *(You can't use its Prelude action now.)*
*Influential*. When you Copy or Pivot to **influence**, you may influence twice.
*Proud*. When **scoring**, you only gain Power if you get first place *(not tied).*

it.name: Nobile
it.text:
*Ben introdotto*. Quando **dichiarate un'ambizione** non ancora dichiarata, pescate e acquisite la prima carta del mazzo Corte. *(Non potete usarne ora l'azione Preludio.)*
*Influente*. Quando Copiate o Cambiate per **influenzare**, potete influenzare due volte.
*Orgoglioso*. Nell'**assegnazione dei punti**, ottenete Potere solo se arrivate primi *(non a pari merito).*

leaders.name: Anarchist
leaders.text:
*Decentralized*. In **setup**, scrap your 2 leftmost cities from your player board.
*Inspiring*. In systems with Loyal ships, you may **tax** Rival cities ignoring control, and you may tax empty building slots like Loyal cities.
*Principled*. You cannot **tax** Loyal cities.
*Remember, if you have no buildings on the map, Rivals can raid your ships!*

it.name: Anarchico
it.text:
*Decentralizzato*. Nella **preparazione**, eliminate dalla vostra plancia giocatore le 2 città più a sinistra.
*Trascinatore*. Nei sistemi con navi Leali, potete **tassare** le città Rivali ignorandone il controllo, e potete tassare gli spazi Edificio liberi come città Leali.
*Integerrimo*. Non potete **tassare** le città Leali.
*Ricordate: se non avete edifici sulla mappa, i Rivali possono razziare le vostre navi!*

leaders.name: Shaper
leaders.text:
*Mythic*. After you **tax** a city, you may place 1 resource you have over the planet's resource icon. From now on, its planet type is the placed resource, and its planet type cannot be changed again with *Mythic*.
*Ancient*. You cannot Catapult **move** from starports, but you can Catapult **move** from gates.

it.name: Plasmatore
it.text:
*Mitico*. Dopo aver **tassato** una città, potete posizionare 1 risorsa che avete sull'icona risorsa del pianeta. Da quel momento il tipo del pianeta è quello della risorsa posizionata, e non può essere cambiato di nuovo con *Mitico*.
*Antico*. Non potete **muovere** con la Fionda dagli spazioporti, ma potete **muovere** con la Fionda dai portali.

leaders.name: Agitator
leaders.text:
*Firebrand*. When you Copy or Pivot in order to **tax**, you gain 1 Weapon along with the taxed resource.
*Irregular*. If a Rival attacks you in **battle** and rolls {intercept}, they ***do not*** take hits from fresh defending ships. Instead, they take 1 hit per Weapon icon you have from cards and resources, then you discard 1 Weapon resource you have.

it.name: Agitatore
it.text:
*Sobillatore*. Quando Copiate o Cambiate per **tassare**, ottenete 1 Arma insieme alla risorsa tassata.
*Irregolare*. Se un Rivale vi attacca in **combattimento** e ottiene {intercept}, ***non*** subisce colpi dalle navi integre in difesa. Subisce invece 1 colpo per ogni icona Arma che avete su carte e risorse, poi scartate 1 risorsa Arma che avete.

leaders.name: Quartermaster
leaders.text:
*Resilient*. After any **battle** with you, repair 1 Loyal ship in the battle system per starport on the map you control. *(Even Rival ones!)*
*Greedy*. In **setup**, place an agent on your Material Outrage slot.

it.name: Quartiermastro
it.text:
*Tenace*. Dopo ogni **combattimento** che vi coinvolge, riparate 1 nave Leale nel sistema del combattimento per ogni spazioporto sulla mappa che controllate. *(Anche quelli Rivali!)*
*Avido*. Nella **preparazione**, posizionate un agente sul vostro spazio Oltraggio del Materiale.

loreCards.name: Tool-Priests
loreCards.text:
**Summon (Build):** Once per turn, build 1 ship at ***any*** city you control.
*Yes, even Rival cities you control!*

it.name: Sacerdoti degli Utensili
it.text:
**Evocare (Costruire):** Una volta per turno, costruite 1 nave in ***qualsiasi*** città che controllate.
*Sì, anche nelle città Rivali che controllate!*

loreCards.name: Galactic Rifles
loreCards.text:
**Fire Rifles (Battle):** Like in a battle, choose a system and collect **skirmish** dice for fresh Loyal ships there, choose a defender in an adjacent system, roll the collected dice, and deal 1 hit to the defender per {hit} rolled. 
*(Hit ships before buildings.)*

it.name: Fucili Galattici
it.text:
**Fare fuoco (Combattere):** Come in un combattimento, scegliete un sistema e prendete dadi **Incursione** per le navi Leali integre lì, scegliete un difensore in un sistema adiacente, tirate i dadi presi e infliggete al difensore 1 colpo per ogni {hit} ottenuto.
*(Colpite le navi prima degli edifici.)*

loreCards.name: Sprinter Drives
loreCards.text: When you **move** fresh Loyal ships, you may move any of them one more time. *(Damaged ships can move with them once, but won't move one more time. Resolve this after all Catapult moves.)*

it.name: Motori Scattanti
it.text: Quando **muovete** navi Leali integre, potete muoverne una qualsiasi un'altra volta. *(Le navi danneggiate possono muoversi con loro una volta, ma non un'altra volta. Risolvete questo effetto dopo tutti i movimenti con la Fionda.)*

loreCards.name: Mirror Plating
loreCards.text: When you defend in **battle**, add 1 {intercept} to the attacker’s roll if they rolled any number of assault dice.

it.name: Corazza a Specchio
it.text: Quando vi difendete in **combattimento**, aggiungete 1 {intercept} al tiro dell'attaccante se ha tirato dadi Assalto.

loreCards.name: Hidden Harbors
loreCards.text:
You always **build** ships fresh.
When defending in **battle**, the attacker cannot collect raid dice if you have a fresh defending starport.

it.name: Porti Nascosti
it.text:
**Costruite** sempre navi integre.
Quando vi difendete in **combattimento**, l'attaccante non può prendere dadi Razzia se avete uno spazioporto integro in difesa.

loreCards.name: Signal Breaker
loreCards.text: When attacking in **battle**, if all attacking ships are fresh at the start of the battle, you ignore 1 {intercept} you roll.

it.name: Spezzasegnali
it.text: Quando attaccate in **combattimento**, se all'inizio del combattimento tutte le navi attaccanti sono integre, ignorate 1 {intercept} che ottenete.

loreCards.name: Repair Drones
loreCards.text: After you **battle** as the attacker, repair 1 Loyal attacking ship.

it.name: Droni Riparatori
it.text: Dopo aver **combattuto** come attaccanti, riparate 1 nave Leale attaccante.

loreCards.name: Gate Ports
loreCards.text:
You may **build** starports on gates, max 1 per gate.
When Rival ships take a **move** into a gate you control with a fresh Loyal starport, capture 1 agent of that Rival.

it.name: Porti dei Portali
it.text:
Potete **costruire** spazioporti sui portali, al massimo 1 per portale.
Quando navi Rivali **muovono** in un portale che controllate con uno spazioporto Leale integro, catturate 1 agente di quel Rivale.

loreCards.name: Cloud Cities
loreCards.text:
You may **build** cities on planets outside their building slots, max 1 per planet.
This costs 1 resource of the planet type.

it.name: Città tra le Nuvole
it.text:
Potete **costruire** città sui pianeti fuori dai loro spazi Edificio, al massimo 1 per pianeta.
Costa 1 risorsa del tipo del pianeta.

loreCards.name: Living Structures
loreCards.text:
**Nurture (Build):** Tax a Loyal city.
**Prune (Repair):** Replace a Loyal starport with a Loyal city or vice versa.

it.name: Strutture Viventi
it.text:
**Nutrire (Costruire):** Tassate una città Leale.
**Potare (Riparare):** Sostituite uno spazioporto Leale con una città Leale o viceversa.

loreCards.name: Gate Stations
loreCards.text:
You may **build** cities on gates, max 1 per gate.
A gate city's type matches all cities in its cluster. *(Players may tax it for 1 resource of any of those cities. If it is destroyed, Provoke Outrage of all those city types.)*

it.name: Stazioni dei Portali
it.text:
Potete **costruire** città sui portali, al massimo 1 per portale.
Il tipo di una città su un portale corrisponde a quello di tutte le città del suo settore. *(I giocatori possono tassarla per 1 risorsa di una qualsiasi di quelle città. Se viene distrutta, si Reca Oltraggio di tutti quei tipi di città.)*

loreCards.name: Railgun Arrays
loreCards.text: When defending in **battle**, before the attacker collects dice, they must take 1 hit if any Loyal defending ships are fresh.

it.name: Batterie di Cannoni a Rotaia
it.text: Quando vi difendete in **combattimento**, prima che l'attaccante prenda i dadi, subisce 1 colpo se una qualsiasi nave Leale in difesa è integra.

loreCards.name: Ancient Holdings
loreCards.text:
This card has one resource slot with a raid cost of {key} {key} {key} {key}.
*(You can hold one resource here. It adds to your ambitions. You can spend it.)*

it.name: Antichi Possedimenti
it.text:
Questa carta ha uno spazio Risorsa con costo di razzia {key} {key} {key} {key}.
*(Potete tenere qui una risorsa. Conta per le vostre ambizioni. Potete spenderla.)*

loreCards.name: Seeker Torpedoes
loreCards.text: When attacking in **battle**, after rolling dice, you may reroll up to 1 assault die for each fresh Loyal attacking ship.

it.name: Siluri Cercatori
it.text: Quando attaccate in **combattimento**, dopo aver tirato i dadi, potete ritirare fino a 1 dado Assalto per ogni nave Leale attaccante integra.

loreCards.name: Predictive Sensors
loreCards.text: When defending in **battle**, before the attacker collects dice, you may move any number of fresh Loyal ships from systems adjacent to the battle system into it.

it.name: Sensori Predittivi
it.text: Quando vi difendete in **combattimento**, prima che l'attaccante prenda i dadi, potete muovere nel sistema del combattimento un numero qualsiasi di navi Leali integre dai sistemi adiacenti.

loreCards.name: Force Beams
loreCards.text: **Guide (Move):** Move any number of ***any*** ships *(even if not Loyal)* from a system with a fresh Loyal starport to an adjacent system, or vice versa, ignoring **move** modifiers in play areas.

it.name: Raggi di Forza
it.text: **Guidare (Muovere):** Muovete un numero qualsiasi di navi ***qualsiasi*** *(anche non Leali)* da un sistema con uno spazioporto Leale integro a un sistema adiacente, o viceversa, ignorando i modificatori di **movimento** nelle aree di gioco.

loreCards.name: Raider Exosuits
loreCards.text: When attacking in **battle**, if there are no defending buildings, you may collect up to 1 raid die. *(This is not an extra die. Follow the limit of 1 die per ship.)*

it.name: Esoscheletri da Razzia
it.text: Quando attaccate in **combattimento**, se non ci sono edifici in difesa, potete prendere fino a 1 dado Razzia. *(Non è un dado in più. Rispettate il limite di 1 dado per nave.)*

loreCards.name: Survival Overrides
loreCards.text: **Martyr (Move):** Destroy 1 fresh Loyal ship on the map to destroy 1 ship that is not Loyal in its system, taking it as a Trophy. *(Your Loyal ship does not become a Trophy.)*

it.name: Protocolli di Sopravvivenza
it.text: **Martire (Muovere):** Distruggete 1 nave Leale integra sulla mappa per distruggere 1 nave non Leale nel suo sistema, prendendola come Trofeo. *(La vostra nave Leale non diventa un Trofeo.)*

loreCards.name: Empath's Vision
loreCards.text:
***While Empath is declared***, if you roll ***any*** dice *(even outside battle)*, you may reroll any number of them once.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to clear your Psionic Outrage.

it.name: Visione dell'Empate
it.text:
***Finché Empate è dichiarata***, se tirate ***qualsiasi*** dado *(anche fuori dal combattimento)*, potete ritirarne un numero qualsiasi una volta.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per liberare il vostro Oltraggio di Psicoenergia.

loreCards.name: Empath's Bond
loreCards.text: ***While Empath is declared***, you may **tax** ***any*** cities, and **build** ships and Catapult **move** with ***any*** starports, like they are Loyal. *(Don't take Captives. Build ships damaged in Rival-controlled systems.)*

it.name: Legame dell'Empate
it.text: ***Finché Empate è dichiarata***, potete **tassare** ***qualsiasi*** città, e **costruire** navi e **muovere** con la Fionda da ***qualsiasi*** spazioporto, come se fossero Leali. *(Non prendete Prigionieri. Costruite navi danneggiate nei sistemi controllati da Rivali.)*

loreCards.name: Keeper's Trust
loreCards.text:
***While Keeper is declared***, Rivals cannot steal resources from you that are the same as resources they have already.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to clear your Relic Outrage.

it.name: Fiducia del Custode
it.text:
***Finché Custode è dichiarata***, i Rivali non possono rubarvi risorse dello stesso tipo di quelle che hanno già.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per liberare il vostro Oltraggio di Reliquie.

loreCards.name: Keeper's Solidarity
loreCards.text: ***While Keeper is declared***, Rivals cannot steal Guild cards from you while you have any resources of the same type. *(If you have both Relics and Sworn Guardians, neither can be stolen!)*

it.name: Solidarietà del Custode
it.text: ***Finché Custode è dichiarata***, i Rivali non possono rubarvi carte Gilda finché avete risorse dello stesso tipo. *(Se avete sia Reliquie sia Guardiani Giurati, nessuno dei due può essere rubato!)*

loreCards.name: Warlord's Cruelty
loreCards.text:
***While Warlord is declared***, you may **tax** cities that you already taxed this turn.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to clear your Weapon Outrage.

it.name: Crudeltà del Generale
it.text:
***Finché Generale è dichiarata***, potete **tassare** città che avete già tassato in questo turno.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per liberare il vostro Oltraggio di Armi.

loreCards.name: Warlord's Terror
loreCards.text: ***While Warlord is declared***, you may spend Trophies in your Prelude, returning them, to influence once for each.

it.name: Terrore del Generale
it.text: ***Finché Generale è dichiarata***, potete spendere Trofei nel vostro Preludio, restituendoli, per influenzare una volta per ciascuno.

loreCards.name: Tyrant's Ego
loreCards.text:
***While Tyrant is declared***, you may spend Captives in your Prelude, returning them, to secure once for each.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to clear your Weapon Outrage.

it.name: Ego del Tiranno
it.text:
***Finché Tiranno è dichiarata***, potete spendere Prigionieri nel vostro Preludio, restituendoli, per acquisire una volta per ciascuno.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per liberare il vostro Oltraggio di Armi.

loreCards.name: Tyrant's Authority
loreCards.text: **Annex (Build):** ***While Tyrant is declared***, replace ***any*** city or starport you control with a Loyal city or starport, respectively. *(Cities return to player boards.)*

it.name: Autorità del Tiranno
it.text: **Annettere (Costruire):** ***Finché Tiranno è dichiarata***, sostituite ***qualsiasi*** città o spazioporto che controllate rispettivamente con una città o uno spazioporto Leale. *(Le città tornano sulle plance giocatore.)*

loreCards.name: Tycoon's Ambition
loreCards.text: **Prelude:** ***While Tycoon is declared***, before taking any other actions, you may discard all of your Material and Fuel to declare exactly 1 undeclared ambition. Do not place the zero marker. *(You may do this just after declaring Tycoon.)*

it.name: Ambizione del Magnate
it.text: **Preludio:** ***Finché Magnate è dichiarata***, prima di compiere qualsiasi altra azione, potete scartare tutto il vostro Materiale e Carburante per dichiarare esattamente 1 ambizione non dichiarata. Non posizionate il segnalino Zero. *(Potete farlo subito dopo aver dichiarato Magnate.)*

loreCards.name: Tycoon's Charm
loreCards.text:
**Prelude:** ***While Tycoon is declared***, you may discard any number of Material and Fuel to gain 1 resource for each.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to clear your Material and Fuel Outrage.

it.name: Fascino del Magnate
it.text:
**Preludio:** ***Finché Magnate è dichiarata***, potete scartare un numero qualsiasi di Materiale e Carburante per ottenere 1 risorsa per ciascuno.
**Preludio:** Potete scartare questa carta per liberare il vostro Oltraggio di Materiale e Carburante.

fates.name: Steward
fates.tagline: Hold together a fragmenting empire while navigating fractious court politics.
path: Assert your authority by winning ambitions as the First Regent.
Extend the Empire's control and fill the Imperial Trust.
Solidify the Empire's control over Outlaw cities and fill the Imperial Trust as the First Regent.

fates.name: Founder
fates.tagline: Build a new order founded on mutual respect and an open marketplace.
path: Fulfill your ambitions and control systems as an Outlaw.
Lead the Commonwealth and spread Free cities across the map.
Protect the Free cities from control by the Empire and players outside the Commonwealth.

fates.name: Magnate
fates.tagline: Corner the market and dominate the Reach with your commercial prowess.
path: Barter for resources and Favors from Rivals during Summits.
Take and hold Monopolies over the resource supplies.
Hold Monopolies and escape the Reach with your riches.

fates.name: Advocate
fates.tagline: Connect with the ancient guilds of the Reach and make yourself indispensable.
path: Use and recover as many Guild cards as you can while proving yourself to the Guild Overseers.
Have more Guild cards than your Rivals in a variety of suits.
Fill the Court with Guild cards and keep a variety of Guild suits.

fates.name: Caretaker
fates.tagline: Awaken the Golems to safeguard the wisdom of the Precursors.
path: Control and awaken the Sleeping Golems, then use them.
Collect lore from the Court and from your Rivals in Summits.
Use your Golems to scrap your lore and the Golems themselves.

fates.name: Partisan
fates.tagline: Destroy the oppressors of the Reach by any means necessary.
path: Get initiative even if you Provoke Outrage, and fulfill the ambitions favored by your supporters.
Hold initiative and gather Guild support to burnish your image.
Have the most Guild cards and continue to hold the initiative.

fates.name: Admiral
fates.tagline: Restore the strength of the Empire's fleet and claim your rightful throne.
path: Prove yourself by enlarging the Imperial fleet and using it in battle to take Trophies.
Exert Imperial control of planets and dominate your foes, Regents and Outlaws alike.
Control the Reach's planets and build the strongest navy.

fates.name: Believer
fates.tagline: Open their eyes to the Truth.
path: Add Faithful action cards into play while winning ambitions.
Establish the Ideals of your faith by declaring ambitions with Faithful cards and fulfilling them.
Insist that the ambitions with Ideals are consistently declared.

fates.name: Pathfinder
fates.tagline: There's rumor of a Reach beyond our Reach. We must escape the decay engulfing us here.

path.II: Search for clues and locate the secret Portal. *Abandon your buildings for a Flagship.*
path.III: Guide the Pilgrims to the Portal. *Rivals can gain Power by drawing ships into the Portal.*

fates.name: Hegemon
fates.tagline: Division breeds chaos. Order demands that we follow one banner, think with one mind.

path.II: Subdue your Rivals and plant Banners of a new order. *Abandon your buildings for a Flagship, lose some of your fleet forever, and also replenish your fleet.*
path.III: Maintain many Banners on the map. *Rivals can gain Power by holding them as Trophies.*

fates.name: Planet Breaker
fates.tagline: There are simply too many of us.

path.II: Collect the Hammer Fragments to repair the Planet Hammer, then break a planet. *Abandon your buildings for a Flagship.*
path.III: Fill the Reach with Outrage and destroy buildings by breaking planets. *Rivals can clear Outrage and gain resources by resettling Refugees.*

fates.name: Pirate
fates.tagline: The merchants have stripped us of our wealth, but riches await those who would seize them.

path.II: Fill your Pirate Hoard with stolen resources. *Abandon your buildings for a Flagship, but replenish your fleet.*
path.III: Keep your Pirate Haven secret and safe. *Rivals can gain Power by finding the Haven.*

fates.name: Blight Speaker
fates.tagline: The very air of the blighted worlds seems to pulse. The vines grow with purpose and design. We only need to listen.

path.II: Spread the Blight and study them while winning ambitions. *Replenish your fleet.*
path.III: Dominate the Warlord ambition and ensure the Blight is well-fed. *Rivals can gain Power by hunting Blight.*

fates.name: Pacifist
fates.tagline: The Reach is dying. To heal our wounds, we must feel each other's pain.

path.II: Commit to taking no Trophies or Captives while spreading Psionic energy. *Clear all your Outrage and replenish your fleet.*
path.III: Commit to pacifism while ensuring your Rivals have a Psionic connection. *Rivals will benefit from your efforts.*

fates.name: Peacekeeper
fates.tagline: For the sake of peace, we must eliminate the tools of suffering.

path.II: Control Weapons planets and confiscate Weapons. *Clear your Outrage but Provoke Weapon Outrage. Replenish your fleet.*
path.III: Keep the Reach at Peace by enforcing Ceasefires. *Rivals can gain Power by controlling systems at Peace.*

fates.name: Warden
fates.tagline: The Reach is too wide for any one empire to hold together. To keep it safe, we must return to the old ways.

path.II: Become a Lord by establishing Fiefs and controlling their Seat cities. *Replenish your fleet.*
path.III: Keep hold of your Fiefs as feudalism spreads through the Reach. *Rivals can gain Power as the Lord of their own Fiefs.*

fates.name: Overlord
fates.tagline: I won't bow to you any longer. Tremble before me!

path.III: Control planets and hold resources that match your Outrage. *You may abandon your Flagship to replenish your fleet. When the Edicts are called, your Outrage will make you lose Power as the Reach rejects your rule.*

fates.name: Survivalist
fates.tagline: The storm is here. Let me offer you shelter.

path.III: Build Bunkers and take Captives to protect against the Blight. *You may abandon your Flagship to replenish your fleet. You can no longer declare Tyrant, and you gain less Power from winning ambitions.*

fates.name: Redeemer
fates.tagline: The Precursors taught us violence. The Keepers perpetuate it. A better future means forgetting the past.

path.III: Collect the Relics and then destroy them. *You may abandon your Flagship to replenish your fleet. Provoke Relic Outrage. You cannot declare Keeper, and you lose Power in the Edicts if Keeper is declared but you're not winning it.*

fates.name: Guardian
fates.tagline: Our cities are symbols of our shame. If we keep exploiting the bounties of the Reach, nothing will remain.

path.III: Protect the Reach with the new **Edenguard** ambition—control the most Material and Fuel planets—and by capturing Material and Fuel. *You may abandon your Flagship to replenish your fleet. Provoke Material and Fuel Outrage. You can no longer declare Tycoon or gain Power from it.*

fates.name: Naturalist
fates.tagline: Blight is beautiful. All it needs is a patient gardener.

path.III: Show that Blight is not a threat with the new **Blightkin** ambition—control the most systems with fresh Blight. You can move and repair Blight, and you can stop Blight Crises in systems with Loyal ships. *You may abandon your Flagship to replenish your fleet. Damaging and destroying Blight now makes you scrap agents.*

fates.name: Gate Wraith
fates.tagline: Find the way... Reunite... Make whole...

path.III: Collapse gates to create Passages into the central area of the map, the Twisted Passage, and then control it. *You may abandon your Flagship to replenish your fleet. The Twisted Passage is a space-time anomaly that connects the map in new, strange ways and brings ships back from the dead.*

fates.name: Conspirator
fates.tagline: Yes, it was me! I was pulling the strings from the start!

path.III: Hatch Conspiracies that predict who will win ambitions or tie for first place. But don't be too obvious—Rivals can foil you by guessing them. *You may abandon your Flagship to replenish your fleet. You can no longer declare ambitions yourself.*

fates.name: Judge
fates.tagline: Absolute power corrupts absolutely. Only I can balance the scales.

path.III: Balance the Reach by ensuring players tie for first place in ambitions. *You may abandon your Flagship to replenish your fleet. Rivals can now steal your Trophies and Captives. During the Edicts, you must name a Rival as the Judge's Chosen, letting them use your ships.*

**While the Magnate is an Outlaw, the Reach has an Open Economy:** Players may **tax** Loyal cities more than once per turn. The Magnate may also **tax** Rival and Free cities more than once per turn.

fateCards.name: Golems

*Only the Caretaker can take Golems from the map.*

**Protector:** Repair ***any*** ships of your choice. *(Also 1 Upgrade or Armor with a Flagship.)*
**Seeker:** Take a Catapult move from one system.
**Harvester:** Gain any resource.

fateCards.name: Faithful Cards
fateCards.text:
Faithful cards are a new suit of action cards. When you **secure** one from the Court, draw it into your hand.
When you play one, place the card on either its ***Zeal*** or ***Wisdom*** side.
» Zeal lets you move, influence, battle, or tax
» Wisdom lets you build, repair, or secure
**They have a couple differences from normal action cards:**
» To **Surpass** a Faithful card, you must play a Faithful card on the same side. *(So if a player leads Zeal, you only Surpass if you play Zeal. You can still Pivot to Wisdom.)*
» You do not seize the initiative when you **Surpass** with a "7" Faithful action card.

fateCards.text: **Resolve this for each Fief, starting with Cluster 1 and going clockwise:** The Fief's Lord gains 3 Power. Then, if the Fief's Court token is on a card in the Court, the Fief's Lord may influence or secure that card.

1. **If you have a Flagship, you may Resettle**—as described on the back of the Flagship board.
2. Gain Sycophants (02).
3. Add Reach Rejects Overlord (03) to the rules booklet.
4. If you have no Outrage, you may Provoke Outrage once to place 2 ships at a planet of that Outrage type. *(Do not also trigger Sycophants.)*
*Flip this card over.*

back.name: Rule by Fear Alone
back.text:
At the end of a chapter, **advance** {obj}1 for each resource type you have that matches your Outrage.
***Control by Fear Alone***
At the end of a chapter, **advance** {obj}2 for each planet type you control that matches your Outrage.
» *If you're First Regent, you control all Empire-controlled systems for objectives.*
**At the end of a chapter, you win the game if you completed your objective and have at least 1 Power.**

fateCards.name: Sycophants
fateCards.text:
When you **Provoke Outrage**, keep this card and place 2 ships at a planet of the Outrage type.
**Prelude:** You may discard this to place 3 ships in a system you control.

fateCards.name: Reach Rejects Overlord
fateCards.text:
**The Overlord loses Power based on their number of Outrage:**
» **1 Outrage:** Lose 1 Power
» **2 Outrage:** Lose 3 Power
» **3 Outrage:** Lose 6 Power
» **4 Outrage:** Lose 8 Power
» **5 Outrage:** Lose 10 Power

1. **If you have a Flagship, you may Resettle**—as described on the back of the Flagship board.
2. Gain Vow of Survival (02).
3. Gain the Building Bunkers card (03) and collect the 9 Bunker tokens on it.
4. Add the Bunkers (04) and Captive Release cards (05) to the rules booklet. ***Explain them to everyone.***
*Flip this card over.*

back.name: Keep the People Safe
back.text:
Each time you win an ambition, **advance** {obj}1 for each Captive you have or for each Bunker on the map, whichever is lower.
***Protect Against the Blight***
**Advance** {obj}1 each time a Blight Crisis happens at a planet with a Bunker.
**At the end of a chapter, you win the game if you completed your objective and have at least 1 Power.**

fateCards.name: Vow of Survival
fateCards.text:
You cannot **declare** the Tyrant ambition.
In **scoring**, when you win any ambition, you only gain Power for second place.
When returning Captives, you keep 1 Captive for each Bunker on the map.

fateCards.name: Building Bunkers
fateCards.text:
Bunker tokens are your Loyal pieces.
You can **build** Bunkers on planets, max 1 per planet. To build a Bunker, you must also scrap 1 agent from your supply.
When you build a Bunker, capture 1 agent from any Rival's supply. When a Rival destroys a Bunker, they scrap 1 Captive that you have.
*Building.* Bunkers can be **harmed** like buildings. *(They don't fill building slots and can't be raided.)*
*Tough.* Bunkers take 2 hits each to damage and to destroy.

fateCards.name: Bunkers
fateCards.text:
*The Survivalist can scrap their agents to build Bunkers on planets, which captures Rival agents and lets them keep Captives when Tyrant is scored.*
When a Rival destroys a Bunker, they scrap 1 Captive held by the Survivalist.
*Building.* Bunkers can be **harmed** like buildings. *(They don't fill building slots and can't be raided.)*
*Tough.* Bunkers take 2 hits each to damage and to destroy.

fateCards.name: Captive Release
fateCards.text:
**In turn order, each player with more Power than the Survivalist does this:**
If the Survivalist has any Captives that are Loyal to you, you may choose a Bunker that you control.
The Survivalist must either return all of those Captives or Provoke Outrage of that Bunker's planet type.

1. **If you have a Flagship, you may Resettle**—as described on the back of the Flagship board.
2. Provoke Relic Outrage.
3. Gain Ire of the Keepers (02).
4. Add Rebuke of the Keepers (03) to the rules booklet. ***Explain it to everyone.***
5. Place Relic Fence (04) on top of the Court deck.
6. With 2 players, return all Relics from the Keeper ambition box to the supply.
*Flip this card over.*

back.name: Subdue the Keepers
back.text:
After scoring, if you won Keeper or it was not declared, **advance** {obj}3.
***Shatter the Relics***
After scoring, if you won any ambitions, you may scrap any number of Relics you have. For each you scrap, **advance** {obj}2.
**At the end of a chapter, you win the game if you completed your objective and have at least 1 Power.**

fateCards.name: Ire of the Keepers
fateCards.text:
You cannot **declare** the Keeper ambition.
You can only **tax** Loyal cities on Relic planets if you control them.

fateCards.name: Rebuke of the Keepers
fateCards.text:
If Keeper is declared and the Redeemer ***is not*** winning it, the Redeemer loses Power equal to Keeper's first place.
If Keeper ***is not*** declared, the player with the most Relics may declare Keeper. *(The Redeemer can't declare it. On a tie, skip this.)*

fateCards.name: Relic Fence
fateCards.text: **Prelude:** Once per turn, you may discard 1 resource to gain 1 Relic.

1. **If you have a Flagship, you may Resettle**—as described on the back of the Flagship board.
2. You Provoke Outrage for Fuel and Material. *(Discard these resources and cards. Place agents on their Outrage icons.)*
3. With 2 players, return all Material and Fuel on ambition boxes to the supply.
4. Place the Edenguard Ambition tile by the Tycoon ambition box.
5. Gain Green Vault (02) and Ire of the Tycoons (03).
6. Add Edenguard Ambition (04) to the rules booklet. ***Explain it to everyone.***
*Flip this card over.*

back.name: Give Back to the Land
back.text:
At the end of a chapter, if you win Tyrant or it's not declared, **advance** {obj}1 for each Material or Fuel in your Captives.
***Guard the Reach's Splendor***
At the end of a chapter, if you win Edenguard or it's not declared, **advance** {obj}1 for each Material and Fuel planet you control.
**At the end of a chapter, you win the game if you completed your objective and have at least 1 Power.**

fateCards.name: Green Vault
fateCards.text:
When you take Material or Fuel, you may place it in your Captives. *(Even if you're taking for the Imperial Trust!)*
Material and Fuel in your Captives are frozen. *(They add to both Tyrant and Tycoon, and they return to the supply if Tyrant is scored.)*

fateCards.name: Ire of the Tycoons
fateCards.text:
You cannot **declare** Tycoon or gain Power from **scoring** it.
You can only **tax** Loyal cities on Material and Fuel planets if you control them.

fateCards.name: Edenguard Ambition
fateCards.text:
**There is now a new ambition, Edenguard:** Control the most Fuel and Material planets. *(For ambitions, the First Regent controls Empire-controlled systems.)*
When a player would **declare** Tycoon, they may declare Edenguard instead.

1. **If you have a Flagship, you may Resettle**—as described on the back of the Flagship board.
2. Gain Blight Society (02) and Spore Guides (03).
3. Place the Blightkin Ambition tile by the Empath ambition box.
4. Add Blightkin Ambition (04) to the rules booklet. ***Explain it to everyone.***
*Flip this card over.*

back.name: Live in the Garden
back.text:
At the end of a chapter, if you win Blightkin or it is not declared, **advance** {obj}1 for each system you control that has any fresh Blight.
» *Your Blight Society lets you repair Blight and helps you coexist with them.*
» *Your Spore Guides helps you add Blight to the map.*
**At the end of a chapter, you win the game if you completed your objective and have at least 1 Power.**

fateCards.name: Blight Society
fateCards.text:
You can **repair** and **move** Blight you control. *(They can't Catapult. They're not Loyal.)*
If you **damage** or **destroy** a Blight, scrap 1 Loyal agent from your supply.
In **Blight Crises**, you may spend 1 Psionic to prevent them in all systems with Loyal ships.

fateCards.name: Spore Guides
fateCards.text: **Seed (Build):** Roll the number die. For each Loyal agent you choose to return from the Court, change the roll by 1—"6" wraps to "1" and vice versa. In the rolled cluster, place 1 damaged Blight in a system with no Blight.

fateCards.name: Blightkin Ambition
fateCards.text:
**There is a new ambition, Blightkin:** Control the most systems with ***fresh*** Blight. *(The First Regent controls Empire-controlled systems.)*
When a player would **declare** Empath, they may declare Blightkin instead.

1. **If you have a Flagship, you may Resettle**—as described on the back of the Flagship board.
2. Gain Catapult Overdrive (02) and Breaking Gates & Placing Passages (03).
3. Collect the 6 Passage tokens. Place one on any gate. Resolve step 3 of Breaking Gates & Placing Passages (03).
4. Roll the event die and place it in the central map area.
5. Place The Dead Live (04) near the map by the chapter track.
6. Add Passages & The Twisted Passage (05) to the rules booklet. ***Explain it and to everyone.***
7. Place Passage Storms (06) on top of the Court deck.
*Flip this card over.*

back.name: Collapse the Gates of the Reach
back.text:
Each time you win an ambition, **advance** {obj}1 for each Passage token on the map.
At the end of a chapter, if you control the Twisted Passage, **advance** {obj}1 for each Passage token on the map.
» *Check your control of the Twisted Passage before pieces return from The Dead Live.*
**At the end of a chapter, you win the game if you completed your objective and have at least 1 Power.**

fateCards.name: Catapult Overdrive
fateCards.text:
You may Catapult **move** with Rival starports you control.
When you Catapult **move** into the Twisted Passage, you may continue your Catapult move, ignoring control and Blight.

fateCards.name: Breaking Gates & Placing Passages
fateCards.text:
When you Catapult **move** from a planet into the gate of the same cluster, do the following.
1. Place a Passage token on the gate you moved into.
2. Destroy the buildings you used to Catapult—the starport on the map, or your Flagship's Slipstream Drive Upgrade and Armor. Do not take them as Trophies.
3. Place all ships and tokens from the gate onto the Twisted Passage, the central map area. Destroy all buildings on the gate, but do not take them as Trophies.

fateCards.name: The Dead Live
fateCards.text:
Any destroyed ships that are not taken as Trophies are placed on this card.
After **scoring**, take all ships from Trophies and from this card, and place them fresh on the Twisted Passage.
*It doesn't matter whether Warlord was scored or not!*

fateCards.name: Passages & The Twisted Passage
fateCards.text:
*The Gate Wraith can use Catapult moves to place Passage tokens on gates.*
The map center is now a gate called the **Twisted Passage**.
Gates with Passage tokens are out of play—pieces that would be placed on them are placed in the Twisted Passage instead.
You may **move** from systems adjacent to gates with a Passage to the Twisted Passage.
You may **move** from the Twisted Passage to any planet whose ID symbol is on the event die. After this, reroll the event die.
Players cannot **harm** Rivals in the Twisted Passage. *(Crises can still harm.)* Cities in the Twisted Passage are Psionic.
*After scoring, The Dead Live places destroyed ships on the Twisted Passage.*

fateCards.name: Passage Storms
fateCards.whenDrawn: The player with initiative attaches this to a card in the Court.
fateCards.crisis: Hit each piece in the Twisted Passage. Place this under the top card of the Court deck.
fateCards.text:
**When Drawn:** The player with initiative attaches this to a card in the Court.
**When Secured:** Move any number of times from the Twisted Passage to ***any*** planets. *(Don't remove this card!)*

1. **If you have a Flagship, you may Resettle**—as described on the back of the Flagship board.
2. Gain Farseers (02).
3. Collect the 8 Conspiracy tokens—2 per player color. *(Even if you don't have all 4 players!)*
4. Gain the Conspiracies card (03). ***Explain it to everyone.***
5. Add Scoring Conspiracies (04) and Foiling Conspiracies (05) to the rules booklet. ***Explain it to everyone.***
*Flip this card over.*

back.name: Control the Proceedings
back.text:
When scoring ambitions, **advance** {obj}1 for each correct Conspiracy and each Conspiracy on unscored ambitions.
» *Conspiracies are placed as described on the Conspiracies card and removed by Rivals as described on the Foiling Conspiracies card.*
» *Conspiracies are scored as described on the Scoring Conspiracies card.*
**At the end of a chapter, you win the game if you completed your objective and have at least 1 Power.**

fateCards.name: Farseers
fateCards.text:
When you **declare an ambition**, look at a Rival's hand. You may swap 1 card with them.
**Prelude:** You may discard this and any number of cards from your hand. Draw the same number of cards *(including Farseers)* from the bottom of the action discard pile.

fateCards.name: Conspiracies
fateCards.text:
*You have 2 Conspiracy Tokens for each player color.*
When you **declare an ambition**, you do not place an ambition marker. *(You cannot declare an ambition if there are no Available markers.)* Instead, you place a Conspiracy from your supply facedown in the declared ambition box.
When you **secure** a card, you may refill the Court with a Guild card you have to place a Conspiracy facedown in an ambition box ***with no ambition marker.***

fateCards.name: Scoring Conspiracies
fateCards.text:
*There are 2 Conspiracies per player color.*
After **scoring** ambitions, reveal all Conspiracies on scored ambitions.
» The Conspirator advances {obj}1 for each Conspiracy that is still ***unrevealed***.
» The Conspirator advances {obj}1 for each revealed Conspiracy showing a player in first place for the ambition or tied for it.
» The Conspirator ***increases*** their objective marker on the Power track by {obj}1 for each Conspiracy that does not show this. *(This moves them away from completion.)*
Combine all of these steps into a single movement of the objective marker. Return all revealed Conspiracies.

fateCards.name: Foiling Conspiracies
fateCards.text:
*The Conspirator has 2 Conspiracy Tokens for each player color.*
When you **secure any** Vox card or a card with Conspirator agents, you may guess a facedown Conspiracy token on an ambition box.
If you are correct, return it to the Conspirator. If you are incorrect, the Conspirator advances {obj}1.

1. **If you have a Flagship, you may Resettle**—as described on the back of the Flagship board.
2. Gain Vow of Fairness (02), The Arbiter (03), and Judge's Chosen (04).
3. Add Judge Sets Agenda (05) to the rules booklet.
*Flip this card over.*

back.name: Balance the Reach
back.text:
At the end of a chapter, **advance** {obj}1 for each ambition where any players are tied for first place.
» *If you're playing with 2 players, the resources on ambitions can cause a player to tie.*
» *If a Commonwealth ambition is declared, it only advances the Judge if individual players tie for first place. Do not combine ambition values for this.*
**At the end of a chapter, you win the game if you completed your objective and have at least 1 Power.**

fateCards.name: Vow of Fairness
fateCards.text:
Your Trophies and Captives can be stolen. Their raid cost is {key} each.
If a player steals Trophies or Captives that are Loyal to them, those pieces return to their supply.

fateCards.name: The Arbiter
fateCards.text: At the start of **scoring**, you may give any number of your Trophies, Captives, and resources to Rivals, up to their number of empty resource slots. Pieces Loyal to that Rival return to their supply.

fateCards.name: Judge's Chosen
fateCards.text:
**If you're a Rival of the Judge, follow these rules:**
You may take actions with the Judge's Loyal ships. *(Their ships don't add to your control.)*
When attacking anyone except the Judge in **battle**, you may add the Judge's Loyal ships in the battle system to your attacking ships.
When attacking the Judge in **battle**, Judge's Loyal ships add to their defending pieces, not your attacking ships.

fateCards.name: Judge Sets Agenda
fateCards.text:
The Judge may declare ***any*** ambition, placing ***any*** unplaced ambition marker. *(It doesn't need to have the most Power.)* If they do, they lose Power for second place on the declared ambition marker.
Then, return the Judge's Chosen card to the Judge. The Judge must give it to any Rival.
